stories.title: Apple ordered to pay $5.7 billion over haptic feedback patents
stories.summary: A court ordered Apple to pay $5.7 billion in damages after finding the company infringed patents tied to haptic feedback technology, according to The Verge and Engadget. Both outlets describe it as a verdict for alleged patent infringement, without detailing the plaintiff or the specific products involved. The award ranks among the largest patent verdicts against a major tech company.
stories.whyItMatters: A verdict of this size could affect how Apple designs or licenses haptic features in future devices and signals the financial risk big tech companies face from patent litigation.
